# What is Visor

**Visor** is a supervisor that runs the TSS daemon and handles ZEL Core's events. Plain `tss-svc` keygen and signing
work perfectly well on their own — but if you want a production TSS node to
keep running across epoch changes, in-place updates and chain migrations
without manual intervention, you run the TSS binary **through Visor**.

Put differently: **to use TSS in the powerful way — with auto-resharing and
other event-driven management — you must launch TSS via Visor.**


## Supported task types

Visor can schedule four kinds of tasks in response to configured events:

- `auto_resharing` — re-runs the TSS binary with `--config <tss.config_path>`
  after mutating `parties.list` and writing party TLS certificates to disk.
  Typically triggered by `STARTED_NEW_EPOCH`.
- `update` — change tss-svc binary file. Typically triggered by
  `TSS_UPDATE_REQUESTED`.
- `migrate_up` — launches the TSS binary in migrate-up mode. Typically
  triggered by `MIGRATE_UP`.
- `timechanger` — rewrites timing fields inside the TSS binary's own config.

Without Visor, the above flows have to be executed manually (see
[Key resharing](../run/reshare.md) for what the manual reshare looks
like). Visor automates all of that.

## Before you start

Visor does not produce the TSS binary or its configuration — it only
orchestrates them. Everything Visor points at must already exist on disk:

- the **TSS binary** itself — see
  [Install binary](../prerequisites/binary.md);
- the **TSS binary's own `tss.yaml`** — see
  [Configuration file](../configuration/config.md);
- the **party TLS certificates** — see
  [TLS certificates](../configuration/tls-certs.md);
- the **Vault secrets** (key share, preparams) — see
  [Secrets](../configuration/secrets.md) and
  [Secrets prerequisites](../prerequisites/secrets.md);
- an initial **TSS key share** generated once before Visor takes over — see
  [Key generation](../run/keygen.md).

Visor additionally needs:

- a reachable **PostgreSQL** instance (see
  [Set up database](../prerequisites/db.md));
- a reachable **ZEL Core node** with both RPC and gRPC endpoints
  (see [Nodes](../prerequisites/nodes.md));
- the **core account** of this TSS party (see
  [Core account](../prerequisites/core-account.md)).

:::info
The TSS binary config (`tss.yaml`), TLS certs and Vault secrets referenced
throughout this section are the ones you generated by following the previous
guide in `docs/tutorial/tss/`. Visor reuses those artifacts.
:::
